(Japanese: '''真の最強への道…！！''' ''The True Road to Becoming the Strongest!!'') is the sixth and the final chapter of the [[Pocket Monsters HGSS Jō's Big Adventure]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Jō]]'s {{p|Totodile}} is revealed to have fully evolved into {{TP|Jō|Feraligatr}}.
* Jō defeats {{ga|Blue}} and receives the {{badge|Earth}}.
* Jō learns from Blue about {{ga|Red|a strong Trainer}} from three years ago.
* Jō climbs up [[Mt. Silver]] and finds the strong {{pkmn|Trainer}} Blue spoke of.
* Jō starts the final {{pkmn|battle}} with the strong Trainer.
